category: vps (hosted, Frankfurt, KVM, dedicated IPv4 plus IPv6 /64)

free_tier.stated: No free tier. The $1 Server is USD 12 a year (USD 1 a month, renewing at the same price): 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD, a 1 Gbps port, 1 TB traffic a month, one dedicated IPv4 and an IPv6 /64, in Frankfurt.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a virtual server, not an object store

retention.stated: not applicable: a live server, not stored bytes

egress.terms: 1 TB a month included. Past the allowance the server keeps running and its speed is limited to 625 Kbps until the next month, with no extra charge; a larger plan raises the allowance.

interface_detail: SSH on the guest with full root; a control panel offers reinstall, power, VNC console, rescue mode and reverse DNS.
tooling: ssh; any VPN or tunnel daemon the guest supports. The FAQ states OpenVPN and WireGuard are allowed.
chaining: A dedicated IPv4 plus an IPv6 /64 on a 1 Gbps port for USD 1 a month: a UDP-capable endpoint with inbound ports, with outbound mail ports 25, 465 and 587 blocked until a ticket unblocks them. No NAT is stated.

limits.value: 1 TB a month, then 625 Kbps until the next month

binding_note: The 1 TB monthly allowance is the limit; past it the port drops to 625 Kbps with no overage charge.

identity_cost.detail: An account in the client area is needed and the login arrives by email; payment is by card through Stripe or cryptocurrency through Heleket. The terms reserve identity or payment verification before activation. No phone or ID document is asked for in the pages read; the checkout is behind a sign-up and was not read.

reliability_note: The terms reserve refusal, suspension or cancellation of an order or service at the provider's discretion; the cut to 625 Kbps is automatic past 1 TB.
confidence_note: Price, allowance, port and the over-allowance rate are vendor FAQ and page lines read on 2026-11-04. Identity rests on the vendor terms and the payment line, not on the checkout, which needs an account.

evidence.quote: Yes. The $1 Server is billed $12 per year, which is $1 per month, and renews at the same price. It includes 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB SSD, a 1 Gbps port, 1 TB traffic and a dedicated IPv4 plus IPv6.
